import Mathlib

example (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < a * b + 1 := by
  exact?

example (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < a * b + 1 := by
  have h := mul_pos ha hb
  linarith

example (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < a * b + 1 := by
  positivity
